results.title: The VA Announces New Trial Assessing the Impact of Psilocybin in Veterans With Major Depressive Disorder
results.description: The US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) recently announced the launch of a new clinical trial that will examine the effectiveness and safety of psilocybin in veterans with treatment-resistant major depressive disorder.
